A listening bar for San Francisco. One floor, 2,800 sq ft, 55 seats.
The shop and the window lounge at the street; the bar room under Mother EARF; the selector in a wall of records; the listening room behind it, its Tropos stacks facing the front.
Bar room, the booth, the record wall
Back of house: three WCs, stock and office, the corridor
Behind the bar and the booth (commercial kitchen)
Seats 55 · standing room at the counter and the shop. Post the load at the door (CBC 1004.9).
WHAT THE LOAD TRIGGERS (CALIFORNIA BUILDING AND PLUMBING CODES, 2022; SF AMENDMENTS)
A-2 (a bar, 50 or more). Under 50 it would be a B, with no Place of Assembly permit: not possible at this
Two (more than 49): the street door and the rear door, a third of the diagonal apart (sprinklered). Doors
Required for A-2 at 100 or more (CBC 903.2.1.2). Check the building: many SF shells have them; else a
Not required for A-2 under 300 (CBC 907.2.1). Emergency lights and lit exit signs are.
SF Fire Department permit for 50 or more, with the load posted.
0.2 in per occupant for doors (sprinklered): 27 in needed, 32 in clear at each door.
CPC Table 422.1 for A-2; three single-user all-gender WCs, each accessible, counted for either sex (CPC
422.2). Confirm the count against the plumbing official's load.
CBC 11B: one level, 36 in routes, the counter's 60 in low end at 34 in, 5% of dining seats accessible,
Title 24 Part 6 lighting allowance for the space types; dimming and controls throughout.

All proposals. The building official sets the load; an architect and the city's plan check confirm every line before anything is built. Sources and the permit path: spinoffs/barkhorn/planet/r42/RULES.md.
